description: Frictionless Table Schema of Platform/01-store/forms/status-fields.tsv (ADR-0125 addenda (12), (13); P01.228). Every field is a raw string: no type coercion. Constraints only where the header of the form or the existing check states them; CEL, JSON, owner, typed, numeric and prose-agreement rules stay with the existing checks.

fields.name: field
fields.description: A field of the answer object of GET /v1/status.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The JSON form of the value; its words stay with the reading of the form.

fields.name: required_when
fields.description: CEL; checked by the existing CEL guard on the raw text, not by this schema.

fields.name: allowed_when
fields.description: CEL; checked by the existing CEL guard on the raw text, not by this schema.

fields.name: value_rule
fields.description: What the value is, by the mode and the role; - when the type says all.
